description: This file provides an asynchronous helper function `waitUntil` to wait for a certain condition with a timeout, and a custom error type `AsyncWaitTimeoutError` for timeout handling.

classes.name: AsyncWaitTimeoutError
classes.description: An error type indicating a timeout occurred while waiting for a specified condition.

methods.name: waitUntil
methods.description: Asynchronously waits until a given condition becomes true or the timeout expires. It polls the condition periodically.
